question: What passport or travel document copy must an Express Entry applicant provide?

claims.text: A clear and legible copy of the biographical data page of a passport or travel document must be provided.
claims.quote: * A clear and legible copy of the biographical data page of a passport or travel document must be provided.

basis: The principal applicant submitted a single-page PDF document (opaque case ID 6905c8726394082c7692d8a43533fed7) under the passport document upload slot.
The document contains passport page images formatted for biographical data page review.
prose: Express Entry e-APR applicants are required to submit a clear and legible copy of the biographical data page of their passport or travel document.
